summary: A Palestinian terrorist carried out a drive-by shooting at a natural spring near Neve Tzuf in the West Bank, seriously wounding an Israeli man in his 30s before fleeing on foot. The IDF deployed special forces, drones, and air assets to hunt the armed gunman across the Halamish area. Three Hamas terrorists involved in the October 7 invasion were killed in Gaza Strip strikes, including a Nukhba Force commander.
key_points: A Palestinian terrorist opened fire from a vehicle at a natural spring near Neve Tzuf (Halamish) in the West Bank, seriously wounding an Israeli man in his 30s before fleeing on foot while armed. (Source: @manniefabian/59197)

IDF special forces, numerous troops, and drones are searching for the armed gunman on foot in the Halamish area, with Israeli Air Force aircraft dispatched to assist scans. (Source: @manniefabian/59197)
The injured Israeli man was taken to Beilinson Hospital in serious condition by Magen David Adom. (Source: @manniefabian/59197)

Three Hamas terrorists who invaded Israel on October 7, 2023, were killed in recent Gaza Strip strikes, including Yahya Hamdouna, Mohammad Rafa'i, and Basir al-Barsh, a Nukhba commander. (Source: @manniefabian/59203)
IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered additional troops to the Halamish area to hunt the terrorist and established a cordon while continuing searches. (Source: @manniefabian/59200)
The gun used by the Palestinian terrorist in the Halamish shooting attack was located by troops. (Source: @manniefabian/59204)
IDF forces captured the terrorist who fired at a spring near Neve Tzuf, with the injured Israeli man later confirmed dead at age 30. (Source: @almogboker78/18229)

sections.threat_assessment: The situation remains highly volatile with ongoing IDF operations in the West Bank following the Halamish shooting attack, where a Palestinian terrorist who fled on foot while armed continues to be hunted by special forces and drone assets. The killing of three Hamas terrorists in Gaza, including a Nukhba Force commander, indicates continued IDF operations to eliminate Hamas leadership and capabilities despite the ceasefire. Iranian rhetoric has escalated with threats of major actions against the country, while US officials signal potential military or economic actions regarding Iran's nuclear program.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors remain on high alert with Lebanon experiencing significant artillery and air strikes across multiple villages, while Iraq faces economic challenges from the war and Strait of Hormuz closure. Gulf states are preparing for potential evacuation scenarios, with Lithuania mapping evacuation routes and Poland preparing transit corridors. The international community watches closely as Trump signals potential major actions regarding Iran while the ICC faces possible US sanctions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Halamish shooting represents a significant escalation in West Bank violence with IDF deploying full special forces capabilities including drones and air support to hunt the fleeing terrorist. The identification and killing of three Hamas terrorists in Gaza, including a Nukhba Force commander, demonstrates IDF's continued targeting of Hamas leadership despite ceasefire negotiations. Iranian military activities including drone shoot-downs and signal jamming operations indicate heightened readiness, while regional tensions persist across Lebanon, Syria, and the Strait of Hormuz.
